title: 菊花賞の後に・白い大輪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After winning the Kikuka Sho, Tamamo Cross is happy to have become a not-so-secret weapon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The experience she has picked up here will lend itself well to the spring Tenno Sho, another long-distance senior G1 race held in Kyoto—and one that her father holds in high regard.
